description: Copy SharePoint or OneDrive files (driveId and itemId from sharepoint.drives.items.list) into a matter as documents, read with the caller's own Microsoft account. Each file is a one-way snapshot: importing it again adds a version only when its content changed in SharePoint, otherwise it is a no-op. Returns one result per file; a failed file does not stop the others, and files the request had no time left for come back deferred: send those again.

items.description: Files to copy into the matter, at most 10; folders are not imported

driveId.description: Drive (document library or OneDrive) id, as returned by a drive listing

itemId.description: File item id from a folder listing

anyOf.description: Folder in the matter to put new documents in
